name: Sphere of Safety
oracle_text: Creatures can't attack you or planeswalkers you control unless their controller pays {X} for each of those creatures, where X is the number of enchantments you control.
blocked_sentences: Creatures can't attack you or planeswalkers you control unless their controller pays {X} for each of those creatures, where X is the number of enchantments you control.

needs.what: an attack_tax static whose {X} per attacking creature is a static value read off the tax's controller's board at declaration -- here {"count": {"zone": "battlefield", "controller": "you", "types": ["Enchantment"]}} -- e.g. x_per_attacker accepting a static_value_keys amount (count) instead of only a property of the attacker
needs.why_existing_wont_do: attack_tax with or_planeswalkers covers the shape, but its cost is a fixed mana string and an {X} price is refused unless x_per_attacker is present, which the loader (_validate_tax_x) restricts to one leaf, 'counters', read off the attacking creature (Nils, Discipline Enforcer); nothing lets X be the number of enchantments the defending player controls, and a fixed {N} would be wrong as the enchantment count changes
